hall.gable_runoff_note: ADR 0116 r1: runoff follows the actual curved flashing, not the horizontal crown level; openings remain below the strip.
hall.openings_note: r3: measured on the CC0 photo 7197 (gable 12 m = 325 px): arched windows 4.7 x 4.6 m (size in atlas_layout.json 'arch'), 1.2 m apart; round window d 3.4 m, centre 4.5 m below the crown; lettering centre 2.1 m and '998' 3.3 m below the crown. WORKING_VALUE +-0.2 m (sill hidden by the thujas). r4 (same photo, 67 px/m at full size): arched windows have 3 lights; round window = one wide blue post + thin white transom; lettering spans 1.5-10.15 m and the digits '998' 2.27-3.84 m from the W corner, 0.6 m tall (the handset roundel left of them, 1.57-2.05 m, is not reproduced: no pictograms, ADR 0070); four ochre vent squares ~0.2 m at 1.37 / 4.22 / 7.22 / 10.3 m, 0.9 m above the lettering centre
